items.prompt: What happens when one duplicate minimum is popped from the worked minimum stack?

options.text: The earlier prefix entry still stores the remaining minimum
options.why: Each pushed entry carries the minimum of its own prefix.

options.text: Every equal value must be deleted automatically
options.why: Only the popped position is removed.

options.text: The stack must be sorted again after every pop
The old minimum is permanently lost even if another copy remains
options.why: The next prefix entry preserves the correct state.

items.explanation: Store enough history with each prefix so removing its last entry restores the prior answer, including duplicate minima.
